name: Aedes Spa
summary: Aedes Spa, a real estate company, provides real estate services in Italy. It also engages in the valorization of real estate assets; investments in income-generating commercial properties; real estate rentals; and sale of real estate inventories. The company was formerly known as Restart SIIQ S.p.A. and changed its name to Aedes Spa in April 2024. Aedes Spa was founded in 1905 and is headquartered in Genoa, Italy.
